video_caption: Hot Stuff Chilli Grower Plants and Jams are the stuff of myths, produced and grown to outlast empires, survive tsunamis, and power the post-apocalyptic feast.
hero_subheading: Sweet chilli jam, grown and jarred by hand.
story_text: Welcome to Hot Stuff Urban Farm, a little patch of resilience at the end of the earth. We’re more than just chillies. From fiery peppers to healing roots, from lush greens to exotic fruits, everything we grow is shaped by volcanic soil, salty ocean breezes, and weather that forges plants tough enough to thrive.
story_heading: From the chilli patch to the pantry
video_heading: Lookin' for some hot stuff, baby, this evenin'
location_line: Grown and made in New Zealand
